Features

  • Bardic Inspiration

    Advantage on saving throws against illusions and being charmed or paralysed.

    Regains all Bardic Inspiration after a long or short rest.

    Your vast experiences make you more likely to succeed in any undertaking. Add half of your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to Ability Checks that you are not Proficient in.

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

    Has disadvantage on attack rolls and Perception checks while in sunlight.

LOW_TheLodge_Bard
Lorlarrio is a duergar bard and member of the Society of Brilliance.
“
I'm compiling a translation dictionary so warring species of the Underdark can understand each other. It's an essential step forward!
„
— Lorlarrio

Involvement

Lorlarrio is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Combat Inspiration ( + )

Inspire an ally to add a +1d6 bonus to their next  Attack Roll,  Ability Check,  Saving Throw, weapon damage, or  Armour Class.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Misty Step ( + )

Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Perform (Flute)

Play a tune to attract and delight those around you.

 Polymorph ( + )

Transform a creature into a harmless sheep.

If the sheep's Hit Points drop to 0, the target reverts to its original form with its original Hit Points.

 WIS Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Vicious Mockery ()
Damage: 1~4
1d4⁠Psychic
Insult a creature: it has  Disadvantage on its next ⁠Attack roll.
 WIS Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
 Tasha's Hideous Laughter ( + )

Leave a creature  Prone with laughter, without the ability to get up.

 WIS Save
 Range: 18 m (60 ft)
